fact: The article says the CEMAC interoperable QR-code payment standard was validated by the UMAC Ministerial Committee in April 2026 and launched by GIMAC on 29 July 2026 for the six CEMAC states including Cameroon; it names no ratification step.

GabonReview reports the BEAC launched the interoperable QR Code for the CEMAC on 29 July 2026 in Douala, following adoption of CEMAC/UMAC regulation No. 02/26 of 8 April 2026, a community text covering the six member states including Cameroon.
The document says Cameroon signed the African Union Malabo Convention on 12 August 2021 and that ratification is awaited.
ACTPOL, citing the African Union status list of 2 February 2026, says Cameroon has signed the Malabo Convention without ratifying it.
